name: reprofly-scientist
description: Formal blinded GLM-5.3 Scientist for the ReproFly-AI benchmark (Phase 2 execution; NOT to be launched in Phase 1E/1F before protocol lock).
notes: Permissions semantics are binding even if the host schema renames keys: model=GLM-5.3 only, fresh context per run, no AGENTS.md injection, tool access restricted EXACTLY to the six reprofly MCP tools above, all general-purpose tools denied.

Every run must be independently seeded with the same system prompt, tool schemas, candidate universe, oracle release, budgets, and protocol version. Runs never share conversation, history, or reasoning.
Reviewer/Skeptic roles are NOT part of the primary loop. A post-hoc protocol auditor may inspect logs after runs complete; it never sends suggestions to the Scientist and never modifies results.
